prompt: Composition: Persistent navigation, dense results table, selected-item inspector, restrained headings. Build for this brief: An independent publication; readers discover stories and read long articles. Set headings in Archivo and reading text in Inter; grotesque heading with neutral interface text. Use Forest and Lemon: page #F8FCF9, text #16362B, accent #357346, secondary surface #F2E64B, text on accent #FFFFFF. Use body 18px, heading 28px, line height 1.75, reading measure at most 56ch, gap 32px, content width at most 1280px and item radius 4px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
